# Hybrid RAG

> Production hybrid retrieval built from scratch: BM25 and a TF-IDF vector retriever, fused and reranked, with a rigorous retrieval evaluation suite.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag

## Source

- [src/hybrid_rag/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/__init__.py): Hybrid RAG - production hybrid retrieval built from scratch.
- [src/hybrid_rag/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/cli.py): Command-line interface for the hybrid retrieval system.
- [src/hybrid_rag/core/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/core/__init__.py): Core abstractions for hybrid retrieval.
- [src/hybrid_rag/core/chunking.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/core/chunking.py): Chunking strategies: splitting documents into retrievable spans.
- [src/hybrid_rag/core/chunking_advanced.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/core/chunking_advanced.py): Additional chunking strategies.
- [src/hybrid_rag/core/retriever.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/core/retriever.py): The retriever interface.
- [src/hybrid_rag/core/tokenization.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/core/tokenization.py): Text tokenization shared across retrievers.
- [src/hybrid_rag/core/types.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/core/types.py): Core data types for retrieval.
- [src/hybrid_rag/data/sample.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/data/sample.py): A small bundled corpus and labeled query set for reproducible evaluation.
- [src/hybrid_rag/evaluation/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/evaluation/__init__.py): Retrieval evaluation: metrics and a harness.
- [src/hybrid_rag/evaluation/comparison.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/evaluation/comparison.py): Additional retrieval metrics and a bootstrap comparison of two retrievers.
- [src/hybrid_rag/evaluation/harness.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/evaluation/harness.py): A retrieval evaluation harness.
- [src/hybrid_rag/evaluation/metrics.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/evaluation/metrics.py): Retrieval quality metrics, implemented from scratch.
- [src/hybrid_rag/mmr.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/mmr.py): Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) diversity reranking.
- [src/hybrid_rag/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service.
- [src/hybrid_rag/persistence.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/persistence.py): Persisting a chunked corpus to disk.
- [src/hybrid_rag/pipelines.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/pipelines.py): Convenience builders for the named retriever configurations.
- [src/hybrid_rag/query.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/query.py): Query processing: expansion and normalization.
- [src/hybrid_rag/rag.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/rag.py): Retrieval-augmented generation: assembling cited context for a reader.
- [src/hybrid_rag/reranking.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/reranking.py): Reranking: a second-stage scorer over a first-stage candidate set.
- [src/hybrid_rag/retrievers/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/retrievers/__init__.py): Retrievers: sparse (BM25), dense (TF-IDF), and hybrid fusion.
- [src/hybrid_rag/retrievers/bm25.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/retrievers/bm25.py): BM25 lexical retriever, implemented from scratch.
- [src/hybrid_rag/retrievers/char_ngram.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/retrievers/char_ngram.py): Character n-gram retriever, robust to typos and morphology.
- [src/hybrid_rag/retrievers/dense.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/retrievers/dense.py): A from-scratch neural dense retriever.
- [src/hybrid_rag/retrievers/hybrid.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/retrievers/hybrid.py): Hybrid retrieval via reciprocal rank fusion.
- [src/hybrid_rag/retrievers/phrase.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/retrievers/phrase.py): Exact phrase retriever.
- [src/hybrid_rag/retrievers/tfidf.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/retrievers/tfidf.py): A TF-IDF vector-space retriever that fits its weights from the corpus.
- [src/hybrid_rag/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hybrid-rag/blob/main/src/hybrid_rag/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing hybrid retrieval.
